name: orgqr
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::orgqr(Tensor self, Tensor input2) -> Tensor. Builds an explicit orthogonal matrix from Householder reflectors in self and scalar factors in input2. The suite covers square, rectangular, batched and zero-sized inputs, partial reflector counts, invalid dimensions and the explicitly unsupported complex path. The same family artifact also preserves aten::orgqr.out coverage for output identity, resize, noncontiguous storage, final-result casting, input aliasing and rejected output contracts. The functional result does not mutate or alias either input.
